title: Open reference cup: measurement session (spec Section 17)
description: The measurements one session must produce, in the order to take them. Every configuration names the netlist overrides that model it; the frozen blind predictions are generated from exactly these (acoustilab validate --predict), and acoustilab validate compares a measurement directory against them. Human-readable form: protocol.md.

acceptance.source: spec Section 17: after fitting only leak and front volume, within 2 dB to 1 kHz and within 4 dB from 1 to 4 kHz, reported without a bound above

configurations.label: Bare driver in free air, before assembly
configurations.instructions: Hang the driver by its leads at least 30 cm from any surface, diaphragm vertical. Re-hang it between repeats.

configurations.label: Cup in free air, rear plug sealed, front plugs mesh
configurations.instructions: Assembled cup, gasket facing up, at least 30 cm from any surface. Handle the cup between repeats.

configurations.label: Cup in free air, rear plug hole, front plugs mesh
Cup in free air, rear plug mesh, front plugs mesh
IEC 60318-4 on a flat plate, reference state (rear mesh, front mesh)
configurations.instructions: Centre the cup on the simulator's entrance, press it down with 5.0 N in total (plate horizontal: weigh the assembled cup and put 510 g minus its mass on the rear shell), and take this state first in every seating; then, without lifting the cup, swap plugs for iec_rsealed, iec_rhole, iec_rhole_hi, iec_fsealed and iec_sealed, and restore the reference plugs before the next seating.

configurations.label: IEC 60318-4 on a flat plate, rear plug sealed, front mesh
IEC 60318-4 on a flat plate, rear plug hole, front mesh
As iec_rhole at 100 uW (+10 dB): linearity check of the open hole
configurations.instructions: Right after iec_rhole in the same seating, with the drive raised by 10 dB. A linear system gives the same curve 10 dB higher; a difference in shape is the hole's flow resistance growing with velocity, which the model does not include.

configurations.label: IEC 60318-4 on a flat plate, rear mesh, front plugs sealed
IEC 60318-4 on a flat plate, all plugs sealed (pressure chamber)
Damped IEC 60318-4 variant on a flat plate, reference state
configurations.instructions: A damped IEC 60318-4 simulator (for example GRAS RA0401/RA0402, which the manufacturer states complies with IEC 60318-4 from 100 Hz to 10 kHz with the 13.5 kHz resonance damped). The engine has no model of the damping: the prediction is the undamped model, frozen and compared up to 10 kHz only.

configurations.label: ITU-T P.57 Type 4.3 ear on a head and torso simulator, reference state
configurations.instructions: Centre the cup on the ear canal entrance as far as the pinna allows, with 5 N of clamping force (headband or a calibrated spring). The pinna's acoustics are not modelled: the model sees it only as a volume taken from the front cavity (pinna_volume_cm3, an estimate) and a larger residual leak.
